stages.name: first stage
stages.note: Double round-robin, 30 matches each (20 February - 14 September 2026).

stages.name: championship hexagonal
stages.note: Top six, double round-robin; 40 matches in total. Title and Libertadores places.

stages.name: Copa Sudamericana quadrangular
stages.note: 7th-10th, double round-robin; 36 matches. One Sudamericana place.

stages.name: relegation hexagonal
stages.note: Bottom six, double round-robin; 40 matches. Bottom two relegated.

stages.name: promotion round
stages.note: Top six, double round-robin; 32 matches. Top two promoted.

stages.name: relegation round
stages.note: Bottom six, double round-robin; 32 matches. Bottom two relegated.

boundaries.note: Two direct places each way, decided after the split: the top two of Serie B's promotion round go up, the bottom two of Serie A's relegation hexagonal go down. No play-offs. Reserve sides (Independiente Juniors) are ineligible for promotion.

conflicts.topic: Serie A is one season with three final groups, not Apertura/Clausura
conflicts.detail: The 2026 format is a 30-round first stage followed by a championship hexagonal (6), a Copa Sudamericana quadrangular (4) and a relegation hexagonal (6). There are no two separate championships; the single champion comes from the hexagonal.

conflicts.topic: Relegation is decided in a six-team mini-league
conflicts.detail: The bottom six carry their 30-match records into a 10-match relegation hexagonal, and its bottom two go down. A club can be bottom of the 30-round table and survive, or mid-table and be dragged down.

conflicts.topic: The Serie B article describes an older format
conflicts.detail: The Serie B league page's prose still says 'top four after both stages ... playoffs'. The 2025 season (and the 2026 field) uses a 22-round first stage plus a six-team promotion round and a six-team relegation round, with points carried. The 2025 season tables are the evidence.

conflicts.topic: Reserve team in the promotion race
conflicts.detail: Independiente Juniors plays in Serie B and is ineligible for promotion; in 2025 it finished 3rd in the promotion round and the place went to the next eligible club. A naive top-two promotion will promote it.

notes: Calendar-year 2026 season, complete at the research date (champion Independiente del Valle). Sizes 16/12 and levels match our rows. Serie A's final groups carry first-stage points. Serie B relegates two to the Segunda Categoria (level 3, not modelled). Cups, Libertadores and Sudamericana excluded.
